title: Pass 3 Verification Log
description: Per-run append-only log of user decisions against unsourced claims surfaced by the Pass 3 verifier. Persisted to data/users/<user_id>/runs/<run_id>/verification_log.json by POST /api/runs/{run_id}/verify-claim (Wave 4 D.5). Each entry records one decision; the log is the source of truth for whether all unsourced claims have been decided (which unlocks state.verdict flip from partial_pending_user → complete).

decided_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp at which the user submitted this decision.

claim_index.description: Zero-based index into Pass3Bullet.unsourced_claims for the targeted bullet at the time the user submitted the decision.

claim_snapshot.description: The literal claim text at decision time. Snapshotted so the log is auditable independent of pass3.json mutations.

decision.description: approve = user verified the claim is grounded; reject = user agrees claim is unsourced and the .tex should not be submitted as-is; edit = user wants the claim text changed. D.5 MVP records intent only — automatic .tex patching is a follow-up.

edited_text.description: Required when decision = edit. Replacement text the user wants substituted into the bullet.

note.description: Optional free-text note from the user explaining the decision.
